notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed viewmodel sway going berserk when moving left-right with high ping
- Fixed Spectator Ghost radar counting yourself when you use Ghost Locator (results in the wrong sound being played if no other Ghosts are in match)
- Fixed one background map still appearing in lobby UI
- Re-done color correction internally, the only change for players should be the addition of poison fade out, everything else should play out the same way
- Reduced default poison dart damage from 50 to 40 HP overall, and reduced delay between hits from 5 to 3 seconds\
- Increased Spectator Ghost hat collision box
- Updated t_arena, t_castle, t_church, t_city, t_cold, t_dust2ode, t_gym

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed pretty much all instances of roles showing up incorrectly on your HUD, they now get updated almost in real time
- Fixed Revive icon not appearing on-screen when you are being revived after your pre-death state
- Fixed a bug where you would not get your abilities and gadgets if you were revived as the same role you were before dying (Traitors being revived as Zombie Traitors, Innocents being resuscitated as Innocents, etc)
- Joining spectators now correctly clearas all your abilities, gadgets and scoreboard information about you (whether you were revealed, found, etc)
- Fixed background maps appearing in lobby UI map list
- Updated High Standard HDM to use Colt third person animations
- Increased karma for killing confirmed Traitors as Innocents from 2 to 4
- Zombies are now counted as confirmed Traitors when calculating karma (so if you will a Zombie Traitor as Innocent, you always get karma)
- You can only plant one bomb on a bomb site at a time now
- Reduced Clue Locator cooldown from 25s to 20s
- Players can no longer place gadgets too close to each other now (this was easier than fixing the unusable gadget bug, sorry!)
- Players can now correctly get stuck in multiple Bear Traps without glitching out when one of them is disarmed and the other is still armed (although good luck achieving that after previous change)
- Fixed broken UI icon for Resuscitate abilities
- Increased Spectator Ghost hat velocity from 1536 to 2048 u/s
- Added Spectator Ghost hit stat and a new achievement for hitting 500 Spectator Ghosts
- Added electric sparks effect when using Taser
- Updated t_arena, t_church, t_gym, t_hotel and added new background music for 2 new background maps

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Players will no longer receive abilities, gadgets and roles if they died before the round started
- Fixed a case where you would lose a DNA scanner charge if you stopped scanning before it's done
- Health Stations no longer collide with players
- Zombie Traitors now correctly see their own role on the HUD
- Added a "revealed" status to the scoreboard to see which Traitors are revealed
- Increased karma penalty for killing teammates to -2
- Added karma for damaging confirmed enemies (t_karma_damage_confirmed_enemy and t_karma_damage_confirmed_enemy_threshold, default: 1 karma for 50 confirmed enemy damage)
- Added karma for resuscitating someone (t_karma_resuscitate_player, default: 1 karma)
- Added karma for turning on the power supply (t_karma_power_supply_turn_on, default: 1 karma)
- Added karma for releasing someone else from a bear trap (t_karma_bear_trap_release, default: 1 karma)
- Added karma for defusing a bomb (t_karma_bomb_defuse, default: 1 karma)
- Added a limit of uses for Taser gadget
- Reduced max Health Station gadgets for Doctors to 2
- Added a limit of uses for Poison Dart gadget
- Added an ability to disable a Bear Trap without stepping into it by holding +USE key
- Added an ability to DNA scan Bear Trap (only if it was disabled)
- Fixed Bear Trap use icons not showing up for players who are caught in them
- Fixed player roles disappearing in case of a severe lag (full client update)
- Increased Spectator Ghost hat starting velocity from 1280 to 1536 units/sec
- Added multiple background maps
- Fixed Don's hat ignoring model skins
- Added skins to Zombie Don model
- Added Stiletto third person player animations
- Decreased number of on-screen simultaneous HUD events to 4
- Added a separate limiter for on-screen simultaneous important HUD events (hud_event_important_limit, default: 2)
- Added Remington 81 "safe" (lowered) third person player animations
- Updated Stiletto sounds
- Updated High Standard Silenced Pistol sounds
- Updated player death sounds to include a separate "distant" version
- Players will now automatically leave Spectator Ghost state on round end
- Added missing separate Bear Trap release timer for releasing yourself (t_bear_trap_release_time_self, default: 2 seconds)
- Bear Trap will now stop being disabled if someone enters it while it's being disabled
- Added an option to toggle between showing important HUD events separately at the top of the screen (hud_event_important_separate, default: enabled)
- Updated icons for High Standard Silenced Pistol gadget and Stiletto
- Updated icons for Resuscitate abilities to indicate they're an ability, rather than a gadget
- Increased Stiletto walking speed, decreased damage and increased hit rate
- Bomb defused and bomb planted are no longer considered "important" events
- Made Stiletto backstabbing slower
- Removed Doctor Ranged Shield ability
- Added Detective Locator ability for Innocents
- Added Ghost Locator ability for Spectator Ghost mode
- Fixed incorrect Spectator Ghost sound script precache
- Fixed Info Room voice lines not matching the player model
- Spectators who aren't in-game can no longer join Spectator Ghost mode
- Disguise ability will now show up on your HUD player card
- Player ragdolls will now close their eyes only when they become rotten
- Added Disguise kit model that shows up on player models when they use Disguise
- Increased default Bomb range from 1320 to 1500 units
- Added dynamic crosshair setting that makes the crosshair be affected by the weapon's spread (cl_crosshair_dynamic, default: 1)
- Changed default crosshair gap from 9 to 6 to accomidate for the change above
- Fixed upwards movement not working in Spectator Ghost mode (move/swim up/down keybinds in controls settings)
- Potential fix for cornered clues being unreachable
- Updated player rank icons
- Updated Disguise icon
- Removed Disguise from Annihilation loadout
- Moved Doctor Resuscitate ability up in the list
- Updated all maps and their images
- Increased Colt spread and standing inaccuracy
- Decreased Revolver standing inaccuracy
- Changed default Traitor gadget loadout from non-existent Taser to High Standard Silenced Pistol
- Changed UI font for loadout item descriptions

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed your own role disappearing when power supply goes off
- Removed crouching in Spectator Ghost mode
- Fixed Spectator Ghost mode making voice commands not work
- Fixed Revive and Resuscitated abilities not working
- Fixed Bomb being unscannable
- Actually fixed player names appearing through walls
- Fixed spectator bar not showing roles of spectated players correctly
- Fixed Traitor team text chat being visible to other roles
- Fixed a bug that made you unable to attack when you're in Bear Trap instead of when you're tased
- Fixed missing Doctor Heal sound
- Added fixes from main Update #9 Hotfix 1
- Re-added player disconnection messages back
- Fixed Spectator Ghost particles appearing for non-Ghost players
- Fixed Spectator Ghosts teleporting around the map when entering and leaving Spectator Ghost mode
- Spectator Ghosts and their hats no longer collide with doors
- Fixed Health Station healing players much faster than intended
- Added High Standard Silenced Pistol gadget for Traitors, replacing Silenced Revolver
- Updated Karma system:
[list]
[*]Removed karma for round wins
[*]Added karma for damaging confirmed teammates (t_karma_damage_confirmed_teammate and t_karma_damage_confirmed_teammate_threshold, default: -1 karma for 50 team damage)
[*]Added separate karma for killing confirmed and unconfirmed teammates (t_karma_kill_confirmed_teammate and t_karma_kill_unconfirmed_teammate, -2 and -5 respectively)
[*]Added karma for killing confirmed enemies as innocents (t_karma_kill_confirmed_enemy, 1 karma)
[*]Added karma for healing other players as doctor (t_karma_doctor_healing and t_karma_doctor_healing_threshold, 1 karma for 10 health)
[*]Added karma for scanning and revealing as detective (t_karma_detective_scan and t_karma_detective_reveal, 1 karma for each)
[*]Added karma for revealing as innocent (t_karma_innocent_reveal, 1 karma)
[*]Lowered clue deliver karma (1 karma)
[*]Changed low karma threshold (70 karma)
[/list]
- Fixed incorrect Colt eject brass effect on last fire animation
- Fixed incorrect Revolver shoot sound level, making Revolver shooting much quieter at distance than any other weapon

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Additional fixes to the last update:

- Fixed incorrect role icons for Radar ability
- Fixed player names appearing through walls
- Fixed incorrect weapon deploy animations on round restart
- Fixed Disguise gadget being stuck on
- Fixed third person "hanging" weapon models (on players' backs) showing up in first person

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Added Spectator Ghost mode: when you are dead, you can now press your Ability #1 key to respawn as a physical entity in the world and throw hats around at other ghosts
- You will now always correctly spectate your ragdoll when dying without your camera detaching from it and jumping to the floor
- Added facial animation to all player models
- "Approach" hints (when you are near something) now only appear if you are alive (so you won't have "press E on the don to start investigating" hints when spectating)
- Automatic radar will now automatically disable itself on round end
- Added a cooldown to changing your vote selection
- Fixed a bug with abnormally long map change time at the end of the game
- Lowered Silenced Revolver shoot sound distance
- Added clue spark particle to dropped clues
- Aiming at someone in Annihilation will now show them as Don
- Renamed t_post_roundtime_innocents_win_time command to mp_roundtime_postround_innocents
- You will no longer get an extra damage protection when clues respawn in the middle of the round
- Added default player loadout file
- "Clue delivered" event is no longer saved in event log
- Fixed missing textures in class menu
- Doctor will no longer go into pre-death state if Detective doesn't have a Resuscitate ability
- Fixed players alive counter not showing in Annihilation
- You can now release yourself from bear trap
- Fixed scoreboard row background colors not having correct order
- Added Gadget system: now all abilities are divided into abilities and gadgets, you can think of it as "skills" and "items"; abilities are rechargable skills, while gadgets are consumable items which you can use at any time, but a limited number of times
- Bear Trap will now glow for Traitors
- Added radio chat for Detective-Doctor, similar to Traitors
- Added glasses popping when a player is hit in the head, similar to hats
- Round end panel will now only show a limited amount of best players in Annihilation (top 3 by default, see hud_roundend_bestplayers_limit)
- You can no longer shoot when tased
- Fixed voice chat HUD of other players appearing for a single frame when they stop talking in radio chat
- Added poison and taser color correction and player card icon
- Rotten bodies now show up in a separate, rotten skin
- Fixed Zombie Don model having closed eyes
- Changed Doctor eye color to blue
- Changed Heavy eye color to hazel
- Changed Light eye color to brown
- Important game events (that are stored in event log) will now show separately at the top of the HUD, similar to how they all used to appear a few years ago
- Players can no longer be revived by multiple players, HOPEFULLY eliminating a bug with Doctor-resuscitated players spawning as Zombies
- Fixed incorrect "can't attack" message for Zombie damage protection
- Disconnect main menu music is now influenced by music volume slider
- Radar icons will now fade out when disappearing
- Fixed dead players not letting go of using items such as bomb or power supply
- Fixed multiple tracers being spawned for each penetrated object when shooting
- Added melee selection with a regular Bat and a brand new Stiletto knife with placeholder stats (lower range than Bat, but higher base damage and attack rate)
- Fixed game stalling by multiple bomb plants in one round
- [b]Fully re-written how roles are handled internally by the game to eliminate role reveal cheats: please document all instances of wrong roles showing or no roles showing for other players when they should be![/b]
- Updated all maps

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed an issue with consecutive clue waves not spawning any clues
- Opening loadout menu while already playing will no longer result in having to wait for join cooldown
- Voice chat player list will only appear for players speaking in Traitor-only chat
- Fixed freeze panel having missing texture in place of player icon
- Abilities will now be automatically deactivated on round end, so you can't do things like reviving someone after the round has ended
- Updated t_arena, t_castle, t_church, t_city, t_classic, t_gym, t_hotel
- Landmine and Lethal Taser abilities have been moved from Traitors to Annihilation
- Changed the number of max ability slots to 5; bind a key in controls settings

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since public update #9 to be tested:

- Potentially fixed water splash effect spawning in incorrect position when hitting water by shooting through a player
- Updated damage direction indicator: now damage taken affects time to fade from fully opaque, as opposed to initial transparency of the arrow
- Reduced threshold for Bat back hits, making them easier; also added a [i]t_weapon_bat_back_damage_margin[/i] command to tweak it
- Implemented Steam Leaderboards that track some of your game stats; just like stats, they are not shared between live build and playtest build and it's not possible to transfer them
- Abilities will start on cooldown at the beginning of the round
- Increased size of damage direction indicator
- Increased player speed for Bat heavy charge
- Hints that appear when approaching an objective entity (Don's body, clue, etc) will now only appear if you look at them directly, and when you're not spectating
- Added an option to toggle pseudo names and use Steam names instead
- Increased fidelity of lag compensation
- Updated scoreboard to be high fidelity (no longer using a single texture for background) and to scale based on number of players
- Traitor-only global (non-proximity) voice chat; bind a key in controls settings
- Clues 3.0: clues now spawn one at a time instead of all at once and 1st clue is always a phone
- Potentially fixed a bug with double clue spawns when multiple players search the Don's body at the same time
- The game will no longer go into pre-game state (where everyone is gathered together in a circle and can't move) if it's duration is set to 0
- Target dummies in Info Room now show the distance to them when you aim at them
- Forced Annihilation message will no longer show up in chat if Annihilation isn't actually starting
- Dropped clues now get removed on round end correctly
- Added player pushing with Finger Gun by pressing alt. attack (RMB by default)
- Added Finger Gun sprint animation
- Third person player legs should no longer get stuck in rotated pose when players don't move
- You no longer get stats and achievements in Info Room
- Added ability loadout with over a dozen new abilities for each role combined
- Fixed a bug with Revive ability giving rating for Resuscitate ability and vice-versa (the actual values were the same for both so this bug has no consequences, it's just that the wrong command was referenced in each case)
- Added [i]t_force_detective[/i] and [i]t_force_doctor[/i] commands to force the specified player to become a Detective or Doctor in the next round
- Capitalized all role names in localization (traitor -> Traitor, innocent -> Innocent, etc)
- Fixed round end panel telling you that you were a zombie when you weren't and vice-versa
- MP40: increased shooting speed, increased accuracy
- Remington 81: decreased damage, increased shooting speed, increased accuracy
- Revolved: increased damage at range, increased accuracy
- Sawed-Off: increased damage at range, increased accuracy
- Springfield: increased damage at range
- Sturmgewehr 44: decreased shooting speed, increased damage at range, increased accuracy
- Thompson: increased shooting speed, increased accuracy
- Fixed double Zombie Don syringe spawn
- Updated Thompson shoot sound
- Fixed missing hat drop for Medium player model
- New map: [i]Arena[/i]
- Reduced possibilities for players to get revived/resuscitated outside the map
- Changed default clue glow start delay ([i]t_dev_clue_glow_start_delay[/i]) to [b]30 seconds[/b]
- Changed default clue glow loop time ([i]t_dev_clue_glow_loop_time[/i]) to [b]35 seconds[/b]
- Added support for [i]$selfillummask[/i] on [i]VertexLitGeneric[/i] shader when using a normal map
- Selfillum is now allowed on [i]VertexLitGeneric[/i] shader when using [i]$blendtindbybasealpha[/i] (will force use [i]$selfillummask[/i] in that case)
- Fixed material proxies not working most of the time
- You now move slower when dragging bodies using Finger Gun
- You can now drag bodies by their limbs, instead of always being stuck to pelvis
- Added per-weapon headshot damage multiplier
- Increased map vote options count at the end of the game to 8
- Added an option to re-vote after voting once (can be toggled off with [i]sv_vote_allow_revote[/i])
- Reworked "play or spectate" window to be high fidelity, similar to scoreboard
- Added Windows task bar icon flash for the game when you get respawned
- Fixed [i]cl_threaded_bone_setup[/i] causing players to do weird things
- Updated all HUD to be higher quality and have unified design
- Round end panel will now show roles of players you killed or players who killed you correctly for the time when the kill happened, rather than at the end of the game
- Added a key binding to open your loadout (former class selection) without going to "play or spectate" window and clicking "play" again; bind a key in controls settings
- Added [i]SineEntIndex[/i] material proxy: same as [i]Sine[/i], except it does not have a time offset parameter and uses entity's entindex for that instead, allowing for different waves for each entity

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Added lobby browser for friends
- Fixed broken UI fonts for some players
- Updated all maps
- Added [i]t_church[/i] map
- Implemented aspect ratio lock for map loading image, which means it won't be stretched or compressed when playing on non-16:9 resolutions

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since public update #8 to be tested:

- Added experimental P2P connections powered by CoaXioN Coplay, and a self-made lobby system; currently only inviting friends is implemented
- Added health regeneration to Light class
- Added support for multiple Zombie Don syringe entities on the map (currently unused on our maps)
- Fixed missing Heavy unconscious +USE sound
- Increased Bat swing speed
- Automatic radar during annihilation will appear more frequently after each appearance
- Added console commands to toggle classes availability (see [i]t_class_light/medium/heavy_allow[/i])
- Player name when aiming at someone will now have black background for better readability, similar to hints
- Annihilation rounds will no longer appear consecutively (can be toggled off with [i]t_carnage_prevent_consecutive[/i])
- Changed default player name color (when aiming at someone) to white
- Disabled Annihilation damage protection by default
- Changed default max rounds to 7 ([i]mp_maxrounds[/i])
- Updated color scheme for main menu scroll bar and drop down menus
- Slightly updated main menu color scheme (for scroll bars and drop down menus) to be in-line with the rest of the main menu

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed server crash related to new damage indicator
- Ability cooldown sound is now also played when ability can't be started for any reason (such as when it's already active)
- Color correction now works when spectating
- Changed default clue glow start delay (t_dev_clue_glow_start_delay) to 20 seconds
- Changed default clue glow loop time (t_dev_clue_glow_loop_time) to 25 seconds
- Added secondary attack for Bat, heavy swing (hold to charge, if released too soon then it'll cancel the attack)
- Updated all maps
- Fixed Revolver ADS animation
- Changed default Annihilation prevalence (t_carnage_prevalence) to 7
- Sounds of Don's body appearing is reverted back to being inside your head
- Updated HUD round start panel
- Added voting map groups, used for server-initiated level change vote at the end of the game (sv_vote_issue_changelevel_use_mapgroups): the last option will always be a small map, while the rest are normal maps
- Fixed incorrect headshot damage multiplier for Info Room target dummies
- Fixed Info Room target dummies sometimes receiving ~1.5x damage because the bullet would penetrate them twice
- Bat now handles Info Room target dummies as players, which means it's gonna play the correct hit sound and apply back damage multiplier
- Updated Revolver sounds, added missing hammer sounds
- Changed default Bat back damage multiplier (t_weapon_bat_back_damage_multiplier) from 3.0 to 2.25
- Added a separate death sound from Bat
- Slightly increased Revolver damage at close range
- Updated map info texts
- Added a separate, temporary version of Castle for trailer recording

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Updated Bat hit sounds
- Updated Thompson shoot sound
- Changed default Doctor resuscitation time to 3 seconds
- Changed default pre-game state duration to 10 seconds
- Updated round start HUD to fade quicker, not show "preparing to start" stage and show up for longer
- HUD Traitor counter will now only show after the Don's body is found
- Fixed some cases of round restart (such as using mp_restartgame) causing "one minute left" event to trigger falsely
- Added HUD damage direction
- Updated HUD center print label to include a background, always be centered even with icon, and show for longer
- Fixed fishes ignoring player actions, such as shooting or walking close to them
- Removed some unused files
- Updated HUD hints to have a smaller and darker background, that matches HUD center print label
- HUD game events now show for 1 second longer by default
- Fixed Doctors getting player class health bonus at the start of the round
- Updated HUD Traitor counter, round timer and clue counter to be a bit smaller and have similar design to HUD weapon selection
- Updated all maps
- Fixed HUD self voice status ignoring HUD aspect ratio setting
- Fixed HUD aspect ratio 0 not resetting some panels to their default position
- Sounds of Don's body appearing and Don's body glowing are now spatialized in the world, which means they will come from where the body is, as opposed to being inside your head
- Updated several ADS weapon animations
- Updated all weapon stats
- Moved all HUD elements to be the same distance from the edges of the screen

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:

- Innocent role name will no longer show when playing as Traitor and aiming on a player
- Fixed Sawed Off ADS when reloading

- Updated all weapon stats

notes.title: Treason Playtest update

Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed player card not showing when in spectator mode
- Dropped clues should no longer collide with players, to match map-placed clues
- Fixed spectator roles not showing up when power supply is off

- Updated all maps

- Changed UI color for Traitors
- Changed base HE Nade damage from 100 to 88

- Updated all weapon stats

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed round end panel showing kills from previous round, if you've made a kill after round ended but before round restarted
- Fixed spawn points being disregarded as valid if they were within 128 units of each other
- Fixed missing "player of the match" stat on round end panel
- Changed UI color for Traitors
- Added fail message for admin menu
- Made round end panel lower
- Updated all maps
- Fixed missing crosshair when spectating
- Updated scoreboard design
- HUD weapon selection now shows in Info Room
- A match of Treason can no longer be started in Info Room
- Renamed "body_found" game event to "role_revealed"
- Scoreboard now shows only the most important events, as opposed to every one
- Fixed broken ADS in/out animations with empty clips
- Fixed slow crouching speed

- Changed first blood behaviour: by default, the first blood event is now replaced with a first body found event, that will trigger when you find a dead player body for the first time. Use t_firstblood_event_enabled 1 to enable first blood event back

notes.title: Treason Playtest update

notes.title: Treason Playtest update

Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

notes.title: Treason Playtest build

- Added first person legs
- Updated Last Innocent event message text
- Updated Zombie Don event HUD color

- HUD center print now supports icons next to text; currently used for body search messages
- Updated HUD player card icons
- Fixed round end panel being stuck on-screen in some cases (alt-tabbed while round restarts, etc)

- Updated round end panel class images
- Added separate hit mark sound when shooting damage protected players
- Added metal spark effect when shooting damage protected players

- Added a sound when you get revealed as Traitor

notes.title: Treason Playtest update
notes.content:
Changes since last playtest build to be tested:

- Fixed missing death panel Innocent images
- Fixed penetration player impact effect (invalid position)
- Further improvements upon player Revive respawn position algorithm
- Updated damage bonuses for player classes
- Updated health bonuses for player classes
- Added support for health regeneration for player classes
- Separate flag pole for Zombie body
